info.name: FitMirror API
info.description:
Complete API collection for FitMirror — Virtual Fitting Room.

Backend base URL: http://localhost:5001/api

**Authentication:**
- Public endpoints do not require a token.
- Protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.
- After calling Login, the test script automatically saves the JWT to the `token` collection variable.

**Collection Variables:**
- `baseUrl` — backend API root
- `token` — JWT for authenticated requests (auto-populated by Login)
- `garmentId` — auto-populated by Create Garment
- `savedLookId` — auto-populated by Create Saved Look
- `notificationId` — auto-populated by Send Notification

variable.description: JWT bearer token — auto-populated by the Login request test script
MongoDB ObjectId of a garment — auto-populated by Create Garment
MongoDB ObjectId of a saved look — auto-populated by Create Saved Look
MongoDB ObjectId of a notification — auto-populated by Send Notification

item.name: 01 Authentication
item.description: Register, login, Firebase token exchange, and current-user profile. All under /api/auth.

request.description:
POST /api/auth/register

Registers a new user account. All public registrations are forced to role='user' regardless of any role field sent.

Required body fields:
- name (string) — non-empty
- email (string) — valid email
- password (string) — minimum 6 characters

Success: 201 Created
Errors: 400 validation / 400 email already exists

response.name: 201 Registration Successful

request.description:
POST /api/auth/login

Authenticates an existing user or retailer. Returns a JWT token.
Test script auto-saves {{token}} collection variable.

Required body fields:
- email (string)
- password (string)

Success: 200 OK
Errors: 400 validation / 401 invalid credentials

response.name: 200 Login Successful

request.description:
POST /api/auth/firebase

Exchanges a Firebase Authentication ID token (obtained from the Firebase client SDK after Email/Password sign-in) for a FitMirror JWT.

If the email from the decoded Firebase token does not exist in MongoDB, a new user account is auto-created with role='user'.

Required body fields:
- idToken (string) — Firebase ID token

Success: 200 OK
Errors: 400 missing idToken / 400 no email on Firebase account / 401 invalid token / 503 Firebase not configured

response.name: 200 Firebase Auth Successful

request.description:
GET /api/auth/me

Returns the full profile of the currently authenticated user.

Authentication: Bearer Token required ({{token}})

Success: 200 OK
Errors: 401 no/invalid token

response.name: 200 User Profile

item.name: 02 Garments
item.description: Garment catalog. GET endpoints are public. POST/PUT/DELETE require Bearer auth + retailer role. Image uploads use multipart/form-data field 'image'. All under /api/garments.

query.description: Filter by category (case-insensitive exact match). E.g. Shirt, T-Shirt, Pants, Jacket, Dress, Suit, Other
Filter by size; matches garment.size OR garment.availableSizes array. Case-insensitive.
Regex search across title, description, and category fields.
Filter garments by retailer MongoDB ObjectId.

request.description:
GET /api/garments

Returns a paginated list of all garments. Multiple filters can be combined (AND logic).

Authentication: Not required (public)

Query parameters (all optional):
- category — case-insensitive exact match
- size — matches size field OR availableSizes array
- search — regex search across title, description, category
- retailer — filter by retailer ObjectId
- page — default 1
- limit — default 12

Success: 200 OK

response.name: 200 Garments List

request.description:
GET /api/garments/:id

Returns a single garment by MongoDB ObjectId. Retailer is populated with name and email.

Authentication: Not required (public)

Path parameters:
- id — MongoDB ObjectId of the garment

Success: 200 OK
Errors: 404 not found / 404 invalid ObjectId

response.name: 200 Garment Detail

formdata.description: REQUIRED. E.g. Shirt, T-Shirt, Pants, Jacket, Dress, Suit, Other
Optional. Default size label. Defaults to M if omitted.
Optional. Comma-separated sizes. Defaults to S,M,L,XL.
REQUIRED. Garment image file (PNG/JPG). Stored in backend/uploads/garments/.

request.description:
POST /api/garments

Creates a new garment. Retailer role required.

Authentication: Bearer Token (retailer account only)

Body: multipart/form-data

Required fields:
- title (text) — non-empty
- category (text) — non-empty
- price (text/number) — numeric >= 0
- image (file) — garment photo, stored via Multer in backend/uploads/garments/

Optional fields:
- description (text)
- size (text) — default size label, defaults to M
- availableSizes (text) — comma-separated e.g. S,M,L,XL
- purchaseUrl (text) — buy link

Success: 201 Created
Errors: 400 validation / 400 no image / 401 not authenticated / 403 not retailer

response.name: 201 Garment Created

formdata.description: Optional. New title; cannot be empty string if provided.
Optional. New category; cannot be empty string if provided.
Optional. New garment image file to replace the existing one. Old file is deleted from disk.

request.description:
PUT /api/garments/:id

Updates an existing garment. Retailer role required. Only the owning retailer can update.

Authentication: Bearer Token (owning retailer)

Path parameters:
- id — MongoDB ObjectId of the garment

Body: multipart/form-data — all fields optional

Updatable fields:
- title (text) — cannot be empty if provided
- category (text) — cannot be empty if provided
- price (text/number) — numeric >= 0 if provided
- description (text)
- size (text)
- availableSizes (text) — comma-separated
- purchaseUrl (text)
- image (file) — replaces existing image; old file deleted from disk

Success: 200 OK
Errors: 400 validation / 401 not authenticated / 403 not retailer or not owner / 404 not found

response.name: 200 Garment Updated

request.description:
DELETE /api/garments/:id

Permanently deletes a garment and removes its image file from disk. Only the owning retailer can delete.

Authentication: Bearer Token (owning retailer)

Path parameters:
- id — MongoDB ObjectId of the garment

Success: 200 OK (data: null)
Errors: 401 not authenticated / 403 not retailer or not owner / 404 not found

response.name: 200 Garment Deleted

item.name: 03 Measurements
item.description: Body measurement endpoints. All routes require authentication. All under /api/measurements.

request.description:
GET /api/measurements

Returns the body measurements for the authenticated user, plus the computed sizeRecommendation.

Authentication: Bearer Token required

Success: 200 OK
- Returns measurements: null and sizeRecommendation: null if none saved yet.

Errors: 401 not authenticated

response.name: 200 Measurements Retrieved

request.description:
PUT /api/measurements

Creates or updates (upsert) body measurements. Returns saved measurements and computed size recommendation.

Authentication: Bearer Token required

Required body fields:
- height (number) — cm
- weight (number) — kg
- chest (number) — cm
- waist (number) — cm
- hips (number) — cm

Optional body fields:
- shoulder (number) — cm, defaults to 44
- preferredFit (string) — 'tight', 'regular', or 'oversized', defaults to 'regular'

Success: 200 OK
Errors: 400 validation (non-numeric values or invalid preferredFit) / 401 not authenticated

response.name: 200 Measurements Saved

item.name: 04 Recommendations
item.description: Rule-based garment recommendation endpoints. NOT AI/ML — recommendations are computed from stored body measurements. All routes require authentication. All under /api/recommendations.

query.description: Optional. Filter recommended garments by category.

request.description:
GET /api/recommendations

Returns garments recommended for the logged-in user based on their saved body measurements using a rule-based size matching algorithm.

Authentication: Bearer Token required

Query parameters (optional):
- category — filter to a specific garment category

Success: 200 OK
- Returns recommendedSize, fitAdvice, and a garments array.
- Returns empty garments if no measurements saved.

Errors: 401 not authenticated

response.name: 200 Recommendations

request.description:
GET /api/recommendations/size

Returns only the computed size recommendation (S/M/L/XL) and fit advice string derived from the user's stored measurements.

Authentication: Bearer Token required

Success: 200 OK
Errors: 401 not authenticated

response.name: 200 Size Recommendation

item.name: 05 Saved Looks
item.description:
Saved outfit/look endpoints.
- GET /:id is semi-public (public looks viewable without auth).
- All other routes require authentication.
All under /api/saved-looks.

request.description:
POST /api/saved-looks

Saves a new outfit look. Automatically generates a unique shareToken for public sharing.

Authentication: Bearer Token required

Required body fields:
- name (string) — look name, non-empty
- garments (array of strings) — array of garment ObjectIds (min 1)

Optional body fields:
- isPublic (boolean) — defaults to true
- previewUrl (string) — canvas preview image URL or data URI

Success: 201 Created
Errors: 400 validation / 401 not authenticated

response.name: 201 Saved Look Created

request.description:
GET /api/saved-looks

Returns all saved looks for the authenticated user, sorted by newest first. Garment references are populated.

Authentication: Bearer Token required

Success: 200 OK
Errors: 401 not authenticated

response.name: 200 Saved Looks List

item.name: Get Saved Look By ID / Share Token

request.description:
GET /api/saved-looks/:id

Returns a single saved look. The :id path parameter can be either a MongoDB ObjectId (24-hex) OR a shareToken string.

Authentication: Optional
- Public looks (isPublic: true) viewable without token.
- Private looks (isPublic: false) require the owning user's Bearer token.

Path parameters:
- id — MongoDB ObjectId OR shareToken string

Success: 200 OK
Errors: 403 look is private / 404 not found

response.name: 200 Saved Look Fetched

request.description:
DELETE /api/saved-looks/:id

Permanently deletes a saved look. Only the owning user can delete.

Authentication: Bearer Token required

Path parameters:
- id — MongoDB ObjectId of the saved look

Success: 200 OK (data: null)
Errors: 401 not authenticated / 403 not the owner / 404 not found

response.name: 200 Saved Look Deleted

item.name: 06 Analytics
item.description:
Analytics event tracking and retailer conversion metrics.
- POST /track — semi-public (auth optional)
- GET /conversions — retailer only
All under /api/analytics.

request.description:
POST /api/analytics/track

Tracks a try-on or purchase-click event for a garment.

Authentication: Optional
- If Authorization header is present, the request is authenticated and user is attached to the event.
- If unauthenticated, user is stored as null.

Required body fields:
- garmentId (string) — MongoDB ObjectId of the garment
- eventType (string) — must be exactly 'try_on' or 'purchase_click'

Success: 201 Created
Errors: 400 missing/invalid fields / 404 garment not found

response.name: 201 Event Tracked

request.description:
GET /api/analytics/conversions

Returns conversion analytics (try-on counts, purchase clicks, conversion rates) for all garments belonging to the authenticated retailer.

Authentication: Bearer Token required — retailer role only

Success: 200 OK
Errors: 401 not authenticated / 403 not a retailer

response.name: 200 Conversion Analytics

item.name: 07 Notifications
item.description:
In-app notifications with Socket.io real-time delivery.
- POST /send — retailer only
- GET / — any authenticated user
- PUT /:id/read — any authenticated user
All under /api/notifications.

request.description:
GET /api/notifications

Returns the latest 30 notifications for the authenticated user, sorted by newest first.

Authentication: Bearer Token required

Success: 200 OK
Errors: 401 not authenticated

response.name: 200 Notifications

request.description:
PUT /api/notifications/:id/read

Marks a specific notification as read (read: true). Notification must belong to the authenticated user.

Authentication: Bearer Token required

Path parameters:
- id — MongoDB ObjectId of the notification

Success: 200 OK — returns updated notification document
Errors: 401 not authenticated / 404 notification not found or not owned by this user

response.name: 200 Marked As Read

request.description:
POST /api/notifications/send

Sends a notification to a target user. Stored in MongoDB AND emitted real-time via Socket.io.

Authentication: Bearer Token required — retailer role only

Required body fields:
- recipientId (string) — MongoDB ObjectId of the target user
- title (string) — notification title, non-empty
- message (string) — notification body text, non-empty

Success: 201 Created
Errors: 400 missing fields / 401 not authenticated / 403 not a retailer

response.name: 201 Notification Sent

formdata.description: REQUIRED. Full-body photo file (JPG/PNG). Uploaded via Multer and stored in backend/uploads/. Updates user.photoUrl in MongoDB.

request.description:
POST /api/user/upload

Uploads a full-body photo for the authenticated user. The file is stored locally via Multer in backend/uploads/ and the user's photoUrl field in MongoDB is updated.

Authentication: Bearer Token required

Body: multipart/form-data

Required fields:
- photo (file) — image file (JPG or PNG)

Success: 200 OK — returns new photoUrl and updated user document
Errors: 400 no file uploaded / 401 not authenticated

response.name: 200 Photo Uploaded
